landing.heroTitle: Collect anime characters, one print at a time
landing.heroSubtitle: Manga Society is a free card-collection game: open boosters, collect characters and etch your name into the history of every print.

1.title: Character rarity
1.description: Every character belongs to one of 6 rarity tiers, computed from AniList popularity: from Common to Mythic.

2.title: Karuta print
2.description: Every card gets a print number etched on drop, unique per character and never recycled. Print #1 belongs to the first owner forever.

3.title: Collect, burn, customize
3.description: Complete your album, burn duplicates for chakra and decorate your best cards with frames, holos and dyes.

installBanner.title: Install Manga Society on your device

ios.title: Install on iOS
ios.step1: Tap Safari's Share button (square with an upward arrow).
ios.step2: Scroll down and select "Add to Home Screen".
ios.step3: Confirm with "Add": the app now sits on your home screen.

mentions.title: Legal notice
paragraphs: Manga Society is a free website for collecting anime character cards, available online.
Publisher: the Manga Society team. Hosting: Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA.
For any question, reach the team through the project's official channels.

cgu.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: Using Manga Society is free and restricted to personal, non-commercial use.
Accounts are personal: the username picked at sign-up is public and shown on your profile.
Any attempt to cheat, abuse automation or bypass the game rules results in account suspension.
The team may adjust the game rules (rarities, economy, cadences) to preserve balance.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: Data collected: email address (magic-link login), Discord identifier (if you choose that login method) and public username.
Game data: obtained cards, prints, progression and collection history are stored to run the game.
Character images come from the public AniList and Jikan (MyAnimeList) APIs.
No data is sold or shared with third parties for advertising. You can request account deletion at any time.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: Manga Society needs a connection to load your cards and booster stock. Get back online to continue your collection.

onboarding.subtitle: This is the name shown on your public profile and your cards.
onboarding.rules: 3 to 20 characters: letters, digits, dashes and underscores only.
